plain: An official order issued by a ruler or a court

webster.text: Judicial decision, or determination of a litigated cause; as a decree of the court of chancery.

more.text: An edict or law made by a council for regulating any business within their jurisdiction; as the decrees of ecclesiastical councils.
In general, an order, edict or law made by a superior as a rule to govern inferiors.

example.quote: Aspiring men, armies and navies, have not often been kept in tolerable order by the decrees of a senate or an executive council.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XIV, Jan. 17, 1788
